g.text: Each radio channel is galvanically isolated: 600R audio transformers (RX + TX) and PC817 optos for PTT key and COR/squelch sense.

g.desc: Each radio channel is galvanically isolated: 600R audio transformers (RX + TX) and PC817 optos for PTT key and COR/squelch sense.

g.text: PTT keying: opto collector (KEY) pulls to radio ground (RET) - max 50mA, 35V. Fit MOV/TVS across PTT lines for HF coupler kick-back.

g.desc: PTT keying: opto collector (KEY) pulls to radio ground (RET) - max 50mA, 35V. Fit MOV/TVS across PTT lines for HF coupler kick-back.

g.text: VHF ch: J5 pins 1/14 RX audio, 2/15 mic audio, 3/16 PTT, 4/17 COR. HF ch: 6/19, 7/20, 8/21, 9/22. 13/25 chassis.
